_comment: Machines allowed to run Awake Console. Published to the public release
channel by CI, and read by every installed copy.
To enrol somebody: they open Awake, press Setup, press 'Copy my machine
id', and send you the hash. Add it below with a name in a comment, commit,
push. Their copy picks it up on its next check, or immediately when they
To revoke: delete the line. Their next check drops the grant.
These are SHA-256 hashes of the Windows MachineGuid. They identify nobody,
reveal no address, and grant nothing on their own: Console still binds
loopback only and still needs a token generated on the machine it runs on.
That is why this file is safe to publish.
